description.text: "This program is to cultivate students to master basic theory and knowledge of tourism management subjects, know the development in tourism, aquire the ability of analyzing and settling problems by utilizing tourism management theory and be qualified for careers in tourism administration departments at all leves, tourism enterprizes and tourism institutions. Major Courses: Management, Micro-economics, Macro-economics, Accounting, Management Information System, Statistics, Financial Management, Marketing Management, Economic Law, Brief Introduction of Tourism, Tourism Economics, Hotel Management Principle, Tourism Resources and Their Development, etc. Degree Awarded: Bachelor’s Degree in Management"

duration.text: The Tourism Management at Yanshan University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2180 USD/per year ￥ 15700 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) The copy of HSK level certificate (Level-6 is required by Liberal Arts majors and Level-4 is required by Sciences majors). 6.Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1.Applicant should be over 18 years in age 2. Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate 3. Certificate of HSK 4. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 5. Have good moral character and obey the laws and regulations of the Chinese government and regulations of the university. Respect Chinese social customs and habits. 6. Be in good health condition
